name: read-boundary-mass-halves
authority: Research 0129 section 3; this contract authorizes one bounded run and nothing else
question: At a read boundary the probability mass is said to split half and half: one half resolved and one half remaining. Which partition is that, is it exact, and what does an allocation of a shared step allowance do to the two halves?
level: External exact rational arithmetic over Q: the declared self-delimiting wrapper family, its layer masses, the resolved and remaining identities, a budget-to-remaining-mass map under a declared cost model, and an exhaustive allocation comparison
domain: The wrapper family E(w) = 1^|w| 0 w that the Zot weighted-sharing calibration declares, the raw first-bit cylinders of the plain binary space, and a declared cost model in which one code bit costs one time step and a word's allowance is shared across the boundaries it is evaluated at; nothing about a Go position, a Q4 filler value, or a CEK transition is computed here

objects.the_direction_hypothesis: The direction's intuition, recorded verbatim so that it can be tested rather than paraphrased: 杨路论文和 Q_4 结合的时候，涉及时空资源的分配，当时给得似乎剩余概率质量（权重）是 0.5 和 0.5。 This contract tests the two numbers and the allocation question, not the join with Yang Lu's method.
objects.wrapper_family: E(w) = 1^|w| 0 w, so the code of a length-n word has 2n+1 bits and measure 2^-(2n+1); the family is prefix-free because two words of different length disagree at the shorter delimiter.
objects.layer_mass: The length-n layer is 2^n words of measure 2^-(2n+1), so the layer has mass 2^-(n+1) and every layer beyond N has mass 2^-(N+1). The calibration verifies this claim rather than quoting it.
objects.resolved_and_remaining: At a depth cut N the resolved mass is the sum of the layer masses up to N and the remaining mass is the tail beyond it; their sum is one.
objects.first_bit_partition: The plain binary space splits into the two cylinders of words beginning with zero and with one, each of mass one half. This is a partition of the space; the resolved and remaining partition is not the same object even when the two numbers agree.
objects.declared_cost_model: One code bit costs one time step, a boundary costs one space unit, and a word shares its declared allowance across every boundary at which it is evaluated. This is a declared model and not the measured CEK transition count of the retained calibration.
objects.allocation: A total allowance A split across two boundaries as (a1, a2) with a1 + a2 <= A; each boundary resolves the layers its share pays for, and the resolved mass is the sum.
objects.multiplicity_hazard: A quotient that counts one representative erases the other cylinder's mass; the defect is exactly the erased mass, which is why a representative's weight cannot replace its fibre's mass.

imported_assumptions: The wrapper family and its layer masses are read from docs/research/zot-prefix-machine-weighted-sharing.md; this run recomputes them exactly instead of accepting the prose
The two first-bit cylinders and the conditional halting probability of one half are read from the retained Keraia prefix search; only their masses are recomputed here
The Q4 and M6 relation shapes named in Research 0105 are the direction's vocabulary for a Go search quotient; this run declares its own identification and computes no Go value and no filler
protected: The committed records are read, never rewritten: the Zot weighted-sharing note, the Keraia mass bounds, Research 0105, and the terminology registration
No claim that Yang Lu's successive difference substitution certifies anything here; the quantities computed are exact rationals and no cone certificate is used or refuted
No claim that the direction's intuition is correct or incorrect as a whole: only the two numbers and the allocation question are tested
residual: The cost model is declared, not measured: the retained calibration's CEK transitions are not reproduced
The join with Yang Lu's method is not tested; what is tested is a partition and an allocation
Whether the direction's 0.5 and 0.5 came from this boundary, from the allocation fixed point, or from a third place is not decided here
